name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=animate, descriptor=attack_hit_sequence. Accurately describes the per-step weapon-attack hit animation (sprite + SFX + pose) played at the defender tile. No Ghidra address residue; no stale domain ID. Matches body and sole caller.
purpose: Plays the per-step weapon-attack hit animation (hit sprite + SFX + attacker pose switch) at the defender's on-screen tile.
logic_summary: Resolves the attacker's equipped weapon (find_equipped_item_by_kind(idx,0) -> inventory_slot_item_id -> get_item_effect_entry), maps weapon attack-pattern id (pWeapon[0]) to a pattern table via fd2_get_attack_anim_pattern_for_weapon. step_count=pattern[0]. Computes the defender's screen pixel position from runtime_char pos minus the view-window origin (x*0x18+4, y*0x18). Loops step_iter in 0..step_count: reads sfx_id=pattern[step*2+2] (0xFF=silent); if a miss (last_hit_or_miss_flag!=0) forces sfx_id=4 (whoosh), then fd2_play_sfx_with_handle. On a hit only, step 0 paints the attack pose (mode 2, color 0xFD) and step 1 restores idle (mode 0). Each step allocs+blits hit sprite pattern[step*2+1] at the defender tile, delays 0x50 ms, then cleans up using the SAVE-BLOCK HANDLE returned by the alloc call (asm 0x1EA86 MOV ESI,EAX -> 0x1EA9F PUSH ESI). void.

params.name: attacker_idx
params.semantics: Runtime-character index of the attacker; used to look up the equipped weapon (find_equipped_item_by_kind(attacker_idx,0) -> weapon -> attack pattern).
params.reason: Matches usage (weapon lookup is keyed on this index) and sole caller passes the attacker index. No address residue.

params.name: defender_idx
params.semantics: Runtime-character index of the defender; indexes data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr for the tile position and is the paint target (EBP) for the pose sprites.
params.reason: Matches usage (position + paint target) and sole caller passes the defender index. No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; produces the on-screen hit animation as a side effect.

comment_original_issue: Comment was accurate but line 970 listed the paint-target address redundantly/imprecisely as '0x1E99D / 0x1EA4E / 0x1EA4E' (0x1EA4E duplicated). Refined to: arg2 -> EBP at 0x1E99D, pushed as paint target at 0x1EA4E where both pose paths converge.
notes: EAX-bug confirmed by disassembly: alloc_and_blit at 0x1EA81 returns the save-block handle (0x1EA86 MOV ESI,EAX), passed to cleanup at 0x1EA9F PUSH ESI / 0x1EAA0 CALL. The src code (saved_block) implements the faithful argument; Ghidra's decompiler wrongly reused sprite_buf_arg after losing EAX across the CALL. Sole caller fd2_animate_combat_hit_with_hp_drain @ 0x1E856 passes (attacker_idx, defender_idx).
